constants.name: eval_episodes_per_level
constants.why: number of evaluation episodes per shift level (method/run.py evaluate)

constants.name: euler_step_tau
constants.why: Euler integration step of the CartPole dynamics in seconds (TAU in method/run.py)

constants.name: dynamics_check_steps
constants.why: number of steps in the simulator-vs-gymnasium check (method/check_dynamics.py)

constants.name: mlp_inputs
constants.why: policy input size = CartPole state dimension; also the number of randomised parameters and of main systems

constants.name: mlp_hidden_units
constants.why: hidden units of the policy MLP (H in method/run.py)

constants.name: mlp_outputs
constants.why: policy output size

constants.name: mlp_parameters
constants.why: parameter count of the 4-8-1 MLP (NP in method/run.py)

constants.name: cem_population
constants.why: CEM candidates per iteration (--pop default)

constants.name: cem_envs_per_iteration
constants.why: randomised episodes each CEM candidate is evaluated on (--n_env default)

constants.name: cem_elite_percent
constants.why: CEM elite fraction in percent (pop // 5 in method/run.py)

constants.name: cem_iterations
constants.why: CEM training iterations (--iters default)

constants.name: cem_noise_floor_decay
constants.why: coefficient of the decaying noise floor added to the refit std (method/run.py train)

constants.name: cem_noise_floor_const
constants.why: constant part of the noise floor added to the refit std (method/run.py train)

constants.name: curriculum_step_delta
constants.why: curriculum widening step delta (--step default)

constants.name: curriculum_gate_rho
constants.why: success threshold rho of the main curriculum (--thresh)

constants.name: curriculum_w_max
constants.why: curriculum cap on the half-width, equal to wide DR (--wmax 1.0)

constants.name: ungated_rho
constants.why: threshold that turns the curriculum into an ungated linear schedule; also the nominal width w=0

constants.name: return_cap
constants.why: maximum episode length / return of CartPole-v1 (T_MAX in method/run.py)

constants.name: width_narrow
constants.why: training half-width of narrow DR; also an evaluation shift level

constants.name: width_half
constants.why: evaluation shift level and sweep width 0.5; also gate threshold 0.5 in the ablation

constants.name: eval_level_075
constants.why: evaluation shift level w=0.75

constants.name: width_1p5
constants.why: evaluation shift level and sweep width 1.5

constants.name: width_2
constants.why: largest evaluation shift level and sweep width 2

constants.name: width_3
constants.why: largest sweep training width

constants.name: gate_high
constants.why: gate threshold 0.95 in the curriculum ablation

constants.name: n_seeds
constants.why: seeds per system (seeds 0-4 in research.yaml)

constants.name: eval_shift_levels
constants.why: number of shifted evaluation levels averaged in ret_robust

constants.name: sweep_widths
constants.why: number of training widths in the sweep
